words.ex_en: She was working Thursday.
words.ex_zh: 她星期四在工作。

words.ex_en: Diane won’t be here Friday.
words.ex_zh: 星期五黛安娜不来这里。

words.ex_en: The festivities begin Saturday.
words.ex_zh: 庆祝活动从星期六开始。

words.ex_en: What are you doing Sunday?
words.ex_zh: 你星期天做什么？

words.ex_en: Are you doing anything nice this weekend?
words.ex_zh: 这个周末你有什么好的安排？

words.ex_en: This shirt needs washing.
words.ex_zh: 这件衬衫该洗洗了。

words.ex_en: Went in to a laundry to wash my clothes down.
words.ex_zh: 走进一家洗衣店去清洗我的衣服。

words.ex_en: Do you mind if I watch?
words.ex_zh: 你介意我看着吗？

words.ex_en: I settled back to watch TV.
words.ex_zh: 我舒适地仰坐着看电视。

words.ex_en: ‘Will Kay come?’ ‘She may do.’
words.ex_zh: “凯来吗？” “或许吧。”

words.ex_en: Do you do homework every day?
words.ex_zh: 你们每天都做家庭作业吗？

words.ex_en: You can’t believe everything you read in the papers.
words.ex_zh: 报纸上看到的东西，你不能全都相信。

words.ex_en: We should read books of real worth.
words.ex_zh: 我们应阅读真正有价值的书籍。

words.ex_en: Kids were playing and chasing each other.
words.ex_zh: 孩子们在互相追逐嬉闹。

words.ex_en: He likes to play football.
words.ex_zh: 他最爱踢足球。

words.ex_en: He did the cooking, cleaning, laundry, and home repairs.
words.ex_zh: 他做饭、打扫卫生、洗衣服，还在家修修补补。

words.ex_en: She often works at the weekend.
words.ex_zh: 她周末经常要上班。

words.ex_en: Let’s go for a walk in the park.
words.ex_zh: 我们去公园散步吧。

words.ex_en: He looks tired out (= very tired ) .
words.ex_zh: 他看起来累坏了。

words.ex_en: the sport of falconry
words.ex_zh: 放鹰狩猎运动
